en: Find a Shrine Bauble in Lake Elune'ara, and take it to the Shrine of Remulos in northwestern Moonglade. Once there, use the Shrine Bauble. You must speak with Tajarri at the shrine afterwards in order to complete the trial.
it: Trova un Monile del Santuario nel Lago Elune'ara e portalo al Santuario di Remulos, a nord-ovest di Radaluna. Una volta lì, usa il monile. Poi parla con Tajarri al santuario per completare la prova.

en: Martie Jainrose of Lakeshire wants you to kill Bellygrub. Bring her his tusk as proof.
it: Martie Jainrose di Lakeshire vuole che tu uccida Bellygrub. Portale la sua zanna come prova.

en: Return to Verner Osgood in Redridge. Give him the Crate of Horseshoes.
it: Torna da Verner Osgood a Redridge. Dagli il Crate of Horseshoes.

en: Magistrate Solomon has given you a report which must be delivered to General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind. The judge wants you to return to him as soon as the delivery has been made.
it: Il Magistrato Solomon ti ha dato un rapporto da consegnare al Generale Marcus Jonathan a Stormwind. Il giudice vuole che torni da lui appena la consegna sarà fatta.

en: Bring Parker's lunch to Guard Parker. He patrols the road leading to Darkshire.
it: Porta il pranzo di Parker alla Guardia Parker. Pattuglia la strada che porta a Darkshire.

en: Find and kill "the Collector" then return to Marshal Dughan with The Collector's Ring.
it: Trova e uccidi "the Collector", poi torna dal Maresciallo Dughan con The Collector's Ring.

en: Escort the Defias Traitor to the secret hideout of the Defias Brotherhood. Once the Defias Traitor shows you where VanCleef and his men are hiding out, return to Gryan Stoutmantle with the information.
it: Scorta il Defias Traitor fino al covo segreto della Confraternita Defias. Quando il Defias Traitor ti avrà mostrato dove si nascondono VanCleef e i suoi uomini, torna da Gryan Stoutmantle con l'informazione.

en: Kill 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighters. Return to Sergeant Yohwa at the Rebel Camp.
it: Uccidi 15 Kurzen Jungle Fighter. Torna dal Sergente Yohwa al Rebel Camp.

en: Kill a Cold Eye Basilisk, get a Chilled Basilisk Haunch, and return it to Angus Stern in the Blue Recluse. <You must not release your spirit to succeed in this quest.>
it: Uccidi un Cold Eye Basilisk, ottieni un Chilled Basilisk Haunch e portalo ad Angus Stern al Blue Recluse. <Per riuscire in questa missione non devi liberare il tuo spirito.>

en: Climb the intact watch tower beside Stonewatch Keep. Find a suitable container to place the Glyph of Azora.
it: Sali sulla torre di guardia intatta accanto a Stonewatch Keep. Trova un contenitore adatto in cui mettere il Glyph of Azora.

en: Find Eliza's grave. Retrieve the Embalmer's Heart from her, then return to Ello Ebonlocke.
it: Trova la tomba di Eliza. Prendile l'Embalmer's Heart, poi torna da Ello Ebonlocke.

en: Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs. Slay Gobbler and take his head. Bring Gobbler's Head to Karl Boran in Menethil Harbor.
it: Uccidi 12 Bluegill Murloc. Uccidi Gobbler e prendi la sua testa. Porta la Gobbler's Head a Karl Boran a Menethil Harbor.

en: Get the Intrepid Strongbox Key from Captain Halyndor. Use the key to open the Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.
it: Prendi la Intrepid Strongbox Key dal Capitano Halyndor. Usa la chiave per aprire l'Intrepid's Locked Strongbox.

en: Motley Garmason at Dun Modr wants you to kill 15 Dark Iron Dwarves, 5 Dark Iron Tunnelers, 5 Dark Iron Saboteurs and 5 Dark Iron Demolitionists.
it: Motley Garmason, a Dun Modr, vuole che tu uccida 15 Dark Iron Dwarf, 5 Dark Iron Tunneler, 5 Dark Iron Saboteur e 5 Dark Iron Demolitionist.

en: Go to the Silver Stream Mine and collect 4 loads of Miners' Gear. Return to Mountaineer Stormpike.
it: Vai alla Silver Stream Mine e raccogli 4 carichi di Miners' Gear. Torna dal Montanaro Stormpike.

en: Collect the missing pages from The Green Hills of Stranglethorn manuscript. Once all four chapters are complete, return them to Barnil.
it: Raccogli le pagine mancanti del manoscritto The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. Quando tutti e quattro i capitoli saranno completi, riportali a Barnil.

en: Return to Brother Kristoff in the Cathedral Square. Give him the book The Stresses of Iron.
it: Torna da Fratello Kristoff nella Piazza della Cattedrale. Dagli il libro The Stresses of Iron.

en: Obtain a Candle of Beckoning. Summon Lillith Nefara and kill her. Return to Gunther on his island.
it: Ottieni una Candle of Beckoning. Evoca Lillith Nefara e uccidila. Torna da Gunther sulla sua isola.

en: Kill rot hide gnolls at the Dead Fields. When Nightlash appears, kill her. Bring the Essence of Nightlash to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
it: Uccidi gli gnoll Rot Hide ai Dead Fields. Quando compare Nightlash, uccidila. Porta l'Essence of Nightlash all'Alto Esecutore Hadrec al Sepulcher.

en: Go to the Decrepit Ferry. Search for the reason the Scourge are there.
it: Vai al Decrepit Ferry. Cerca il motivo per cui il Flagello è lì.

en: Find the Shadowy Figure. Your clues: He is not native to Darkshire. He is a nervous, jittery person. He left Darkshire and headed west.
it: Trova la Figura Ombrosa. I tuoi indizi: non è di Darkshire. È una persona nervosa e agitata. Ha lasciato Darkshire dirigendosi a ovest.

en: Traverse Dun Algaz. Kill 8 Dragonmaw Scouts and 6 Dragonmaw Grunts. Report to Valstag Ironjaw in Menethil Harbor.
it: Attraversa Dun Algaz. Uccidi 8 Dragonmaw Scout e 6 Dragonmaw Grunt. Fai rapporto a Valstag Ironjaw a Menethil Harbor.

en: Kill Chieftain Nek'rosh. Bring Nek'rosh's Head to Captain Stoutfist.
it: Uccidi il Capo Nek'rosh. Porta la Nek'rosh's Head al Capitano Stoutfist.

en: Gather 9 Dirty Knucklebones from Crushridge ogres in the Alterac Mountains. Bring them to Marshal Redpath in Southshore.
it: Raccogli 9 Dirty Knucklebone dagli ogre Crushridge nelle Alterac Mountains. Portali al Maresciallo Redpath a Southshore.

en: Kill Blacksmith Verringtan and 4 Hillsbrad Apprentice Blacksmiths. Retrieve a shipment of iron and report back to Darthalia in Tarren Mill.
it: Uccidi il Fabbro Verringtan e 4 Hillsbrad Apprentice Blacksmith. Recupera un carico di ferro e riferisci a Darthalia a Tarren Mill.

en: Kill Valdred Moray. Bring his hands to Raleigh Andrean in the Undercity.
it: Uccidi Valdred Moray. Porta le sue mani a Raleigh Andrean a Undercity.

en: Kill 4 Argus Shadow Mages. Bring the Head of Nagaz to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.
it: Uccidi 4 Argus Shadow Mage. Porta la Head of Nagaz al Magistrato Maleb a Southshore.

en: Find the traitors and recover their artifacts, then return to me, you.
it: Trova i traditori e recupera i loro manufatti, poi torna da me, tu.

en: Kill 6 Dalaran Summoners and 8 Elemental Slaves, then return to Magus Voidglare in Tarren Mill.
it: Uccidi 6 Dalaran Summoner e 8 Elemental Slave, poi torna dal Magus Voidglare a Tarren Mill.

en: Charge the Rod of Helcular with the powers of the Flame of Azel, Flame of Veraz and the Flame of Uzel. Drive the charged rod into Helcular's grave in Southshore.
it: Carica la Rod of Helcular con i poteri della Flame of Azel, della Flame of Veraz e della Flame of Uzel. Pianta la verga carica nella tomba di Helcular a Southshore.

en: Kill 10 Kurzen Commandoes and 6 Kurzen Headshrinkers. Report to Lieutenant Doren at the Rebel Camp.
it: Uccidi 10 Kurzen Commando e 6 Kurzen Headshrinker. Fai rapporto al Tenente Doren al Rebel Camp.

en: Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding. Bring them to the Stone of Inner Binding.
it: Prendi la Burning Key, la Cresting Key e la Thundering Key dalla Stone of West Binding, dalla Stone of East Binding e dalla Stone of Outer Binding. Portale alla Stone of Inner Binding.

en: Find and kill Fozruk. Bring the Rod of Order to the Keystone in the Arathi Highlands.
it: Trova e uccidi Fozruk. Porta la Rod of Order alla Keystone negli Arathi Highlands.

en: Kill 10 Syndicate Highwaymen and 6 Syndicate Mercenaries. Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
it: Uccidi 10 Syndicate Highwayman e 6 Syndicate Mercenary. Torna dal Capitano Nials a Refuge Pointe.

en: Slay Agmond's killer, Murdaloc. Slay 12 Stonevault Bonesnappers. Report to Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan.
it: Uccidi l'assassino di Agmond, Murdaloc. Uccidi 12 Stonevault Bonesnapper. Fai rapporto al Cercatore Ironband a Loch Modan.

en: Collect 5 Prospector's Picks. At a forge, smash the Prospector's Picks to create Broken Tools. Bring 5 Broken Tools to Baine Bloodhoof in Bloodhoof Village.
it: Raccogli 5 Prospector's Pick. A una forgia, spacca i Prospector's Pick per ottenere dei Broken Tool. Porta 5 Broken Tool a Baine Bloodhoof a Bloodhoof Village.

en: Take a Water Pitcher from the water well. Return the pitcher to Chief Hawkwind in Camp Narache which is northwest from the water well.
it: Prendi una Water Pitcher dal pozzo. Riporta la brocca al Capo Hawkwind a Camp Narache, a nord-ovest del pozzo.

en: Kill 12 Vile Familiars. Return to Zureetha Fargaze outside the Den.
it: Uccidi 12 Vile Familiar. Torna da Zureetha Fargaze fuori dalla Tana.

en: Use the Sign of the Earth to activate the Pillars of Diamond, Opal, and Amethyst and obtain the Runestones. Place the runestones in the Seal of the Earth to free Blacklash and Hematus. Slay them and return Blacklash's Bindings, the Chains of Hematus, and the Sign of the Earth to Gorn.
it: Usa il Sign of the Earth per attivare i Pilastri di Diamante, Opale e Ametista e ottenere le Rune di pietra. Metti le rune nel Seal of the Earth per liberare Blacklash e Hematus. Uccidili e riporta i Blacklash's Bindings, le Chains of Hematus e il Sign of the Earth a Gorn.

en: Follow the western road from Razor Hill to the Barrens over a bridge. Stop at the orc outpost across the bridge. Give Kargal Battlescar at the Barrens outpost your recruitment letter.
it: Segui la strada occidentale da Razor Hill fino ai Barrens, oltre un ponte. Fermati all'avamposto degli orchi dall'altra parte del ponte. Consegna la tua lettera di arruolamento a Kargal Battlescar, all'avamposto dei Barrens.

en: Follow the western road from Kargal's Far Watch Outpost. At the T intersection, turn left and follow the road south. Find Sergra Darkthorn at the crossing of roads within the Crossroads.
it: Segui la strada occidentale dal Kargal's Far Watch Outpost. All'incrocio a T gira a sinistra e segui la strada verso sud. Trova Sergra Darkthorn all'incrocio delle strade del Crossroads.

en: Gann Stonespire wants you to kill 15 Bael'dun Excavators and 5 Bael'dun Foremen. Bring Khazgorm's Journal to Gann Stonespire.
it: Gann Stonespire vuole che tu uccida 15 Bael'dun Excavator e 5 Bael'dun Foreman. Porta il Khazgorm's Journal a Gann Stonespire.

en: Collect 8 Witchwing talons. Return them to Darsok Swiftdagger at the Crossroads.
it: Raccogli 8 artigli di Witchwing. Riportali a Darsok Swiftdagger al Crossroads.

en: Kill 8 Razormane Geomancers, 8 Razormane Defenders, and Kreenig Snarlsnout. Then bring Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk to Thork at the Crossroads.
it: Uccidi 8 Razormane Geomancer, 8 Razormane Defender e Kreenig Snarlsnout. Poi porta la Kreenig Snarlsnout's Tusk a Thork al Crossroads.

en: Grab a Flawed Power Stone. Bring it to the Altar of Fire before the stone expires, then return to Ak'Zeloth.
it: Prendi una Flawed Power Stone. Portala all'Altar of Fire prima che la pietra si esaurisca, poi torna da Ak'Zeloth.

en: Gather information, then use the Phial of Scrying to create a Scrying Bowl. Use the bowl to speak with Onu.
it: Raccogli informazioni, poi usa la Phial of Scrying per creare una Scrying Bowl. Usa la ciotola per parlare con Onu.

en: Kill 4 Bloodtooth Guards and retrieve Ran Bloodtooth's Skull for Krolg near Lake Mystral.
it: Uccidi 4 Bloodtooth Guard e recupera il Ran Bloodtooth's Skull per Krolg, vicino al Lake Mystral.

en: Kill High Inquisitor Whitemane, Scarlet Commander Mograine, Herod, the Scarlet Champion and Houndmaster Loksey and then report back to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.
it: Uccidi l'Alta Inquisitrice Whitemane, il Comandante Scarlatto Mograine, Herod, il Campione Scarlatto, e il Maestro dei Segugi Loksey, poi fai rapporto a Raleigh the Devout a Southshore.

en: Keeper Albagorm on Stonetalon Peak wants you to slay 6 Bloodfury Harpies, 6 Bloodfury Ambushers, 6 Bloodfury Slayers and 6 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.
it: Il Custode Albagorm, sullo Stonetalon Peak, vuole che tu uccida 6 Bloodfury Harpy, 6 Bloodfury Ambusher, 6 Bloodfury Slayer e 6 Bloodfury Roguefeather.

en: Call of Water
it: Il richiamo dell'acqua

en: Bring 10 Specks of Dream Dust to Krazek in Booty Bay. Dream Dust is gathered from the dragon whelps of the Swamp of Sorrows.
it: Porta 10 Speck of Dream Dust a Krazek a Booty Bay. La Dream Dust si raccoglie dai cuccioli di drago della Swamp of Sorrows.

en: Seeking the Kor Gem
it: In cerca della Gemma Kor

en: Tormus Deepforge wants you to bring 4 Runed Copper Belts and 4 Heavy Copper Mauls to Verner Osgood in Redridge.
it: Tormus Deepforge vuole che tu porti 4 Runed Copper Belt e 4 Heavy Copper Maul a Verner Osgood a Redridge.

en: Enter the Rethban Caverns, reach the first fork, and return to Yorus Barleybrew within the time allowed. You must not die and release your spirit.
it: Entra nelle Rethban Caverns, raggiungi il primo bivio e torna da Yorus Barleybrew entro il tempo concesso. Non devi morire né liberare il tuo spirito.

en: Obtain a Cantation of Manifestation and a Chest of Containment Coffers from behind Anastasia Hartwell. Bring 3 Filled Containment Coffers, the Chest of Containment Coffers and the Cantation of Manifestation to Anastasia in the Undercity.
it: Prendi una Cantation of Manifestation e un Chest of Containment Coffers da dietro Anastasia Hartwell. Porta 3 Filled Containment Coffer, il Chest of Containment Coffers e la Cantation of Manifestation ad Anastasia a Undercity.

en: Find and return Bingles' supplies: Bingles' Wrench, Bingles' Screwdriver, Bingles' Hammer, and Bingles' Blastencapper.
it: Trova e riporta le provviste di Bingles: Bingles' Wrench, Bingles' Screwdriver, Bingles' Hammer e Bingles' Blastencapper.

en: Travel to Gnomeregan and bring back High Potency Radioactive Fallout. Be warned, the fallout is unstable and will collapse rather quickly. Ozzie will also require your Heavy Leaden Collection Phial when the task is complete.
it: Viaggia fino a Gnomeregan e riporta del High Potency Radioactive Fallout. Attenzione: la ricaduta è instabile e si esaurisce piuttosto in fretta. A lavoro finito, Ozzie vorrà indietro anche la tua Heavy Leaden Collection Phial.

en: Escort Belnistrasz to the Quilboar's idol in Razorfen Downs. Protect Belnistrasz while he performs the ritual to shut down the idol.
it: Scorta Belnistrasz fino all'idolo degli uomini-cinghiale a Razorfen Downs. Proteggi Belnistrasz mentre compie il rituale per disattivare l'idolo.

en: Find and slay the murloc known as Murkdeep. The creature is thought to be defending the murloc huts south of Auberdine along the water. Report the death of Murkdeep to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.
it: Trova e uccidi il murloc chiamato Murkdeep. Si pensa che la creatura difenda le capanne dei murloc a sud di Auberdine, lungo l'acqua. Riferisci la morte di Murkdeep alla Sentinella Glynda Nal'Shea ad Auberdine.

en: Travel north of Auberdine to the first waterfall along the Cliffspring River and draw a sample from the pool there. Return to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine with the Cliffspring River Sample.
it: Viaggia a nord di Auberdine fino alla prima cascata lungo il Cliffspring River e preleva un campione dalla pozza. Torna da Thundris Windweaver ad Auberdine con il Cliffspring River Sample.

en: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens. Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.
it: Porta un Blood Shard a Mangletooth a Camp Taurajo, nei Barrens. Raccogli altri Blood Shard se vuoi che ti benedica con il potere di Agamaggan.

en: Speak to High Priest Rohan in Ironforge.
it: Parla con High Priest Rohan, a Ironforge.

en: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
it: Usa l'incantesimo "Teleport: Moonglade" per raggiungere Moonglade. Quando arrivi, parla con Dendrite Starblaze nel villaggio di Nighthaven.

en: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade. When you arrive, speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.
it: Usa l'incantesimo "Teleport: Moonglade" per raggiungere Moonglade. Quando arrivi, parla con Dendrite Starblaze nel villaggio di Nighthaven.

en: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
it: Cerca il Grande Spirito dell'Orso nel nord-ovest di Moonglade e scopri cosa ha da insegnarti sulla natura dell'orso. Quando hai finito, torna da Dendrite Starblaze a Nighthaven, in Moonglade.

en: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear. When finished, return to Dendrite Starblaze in Nighthaven, Moonglade.
it: Cerca il Grande Spirito dell'Orso nel nord-ovest di Moonglade e scopri cosa ha da insegnarti sulla natura dell'orso. Quando hai finito, torna da Dendrite Starblaze a Nighthaven, in Moonglade.

en: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses. Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in Darnassus when you are done.
it: Usa la Cenarion Moondust sulla Moonkin Stone di Auberdine per far apparire Lunaclaw. A quel punto dovrai affrontare Lunaclaw e guadagnarti la forza di corpo e di cuore che possiede. Quando hai finito, parla con Mathrengyl Bearwalker a Darnassus.

en: Use the Cenarion Lunardust on the Moonkin Stone between Mulgore and the Barrens to bring forth Lunaclaw. From there, you must face Lunaclaw and earn the strength of body and heart it possesses. Speak with Turak Runetotem in Thunder Bluff when you are done.
it: Usa la Cenarion Lunardust sulla Moonkin Stone tra Mulgore e i Barrens per far apparire Lunaclaw. A quel punto dovrai affrontare Lunaclaw e guadagnarti la forza di corpo e di cuore che possiede. Quando hai finito, parla con Turak Runetotem a Thunder Bluff.

en: Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls. Deliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine, Darkshore.
it: Usa l'Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler per prelevare un campione d'acqua dall'imbocco della grotta vicino alle cascate. Consegna il Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler ad Alanndarian Nightsong ad Auberdine, nel Darkshore.

en: Use the Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler to draw a sample of water from a pool at the top of the peak. Deliver the Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads, Barrens.
it: Usa l'Empty Dreadmist Peak Sampler per prelevare un campione d'acqua da una pozza in cima al picco. Consegna il Filled Dreadmist Peak Sampler a Tonga Runetotem al Crossroads, nei Barrens.

en: Find Rackmore's Silver Key. Find Rackmore's Golden Key. Find and open Rackmore's Chest.
it: Trova la Rackmore's Silver Key. Trova la Rackmore's Golden Key. Trova e apri il Rackmore's Chest.

en: Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound. Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner. Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.
it: Metti il Karang's Banner sul Foulweald Totem Mound. Non lasciare che i furbolg distruggano lo stendardo. Sconfiggi il Capo Murgut e porta il Murgut's Totem a Karang Amakkar a Zoram'gar.

en: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard. Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.
it: Viaggia fino a Ratchet per trovare qualcuno che sappia dirti di più sul frammento luminoso. Poi consegna il frammento come ti verrà indicato.

en: Sneak into the Venture Company mine southeast of Thunder Bluff and collect 5 Seaforium Mining Charges from carts of blasting supplies, then return them to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
it: Intrufolati nella miniera della Venture Company a sud-est di Thunder Bluff e raccogli 5 Seaforium Mining Charge dai carrelli degli esplosivi, poi portali a Boarton Shadetotem a Thunder Bluff.

en: Stalk With The Earthmother
it: Caccia con la Madre Terra

en: Gather 8 Windfury Cones north of Thunder Bluff, use them with the Mortar and Pestle, then return to Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff with the result.
it: Raccogli 8 Windfury Cone a nord di Thunder Bluff, usali con il Mortar and Pestle, poi torna con il risultato da Boarton Shadetotem a Thunder Bluff.

en: Stalk With The Earthmother
it: Caccia con la Madre Terra

en: Buy or catch a Raw Brilliant Smallfish, then use the Knife Set to fillet it in front of Boarton Shadetotem in Thunder Bluff.
it: Compra o pesca un Raw Brilliant Smallfish, poi usa il Knife Set per sfilettarlo davanti a Boarton Shadetotem a Thunder Bluff.

en: Stalk With The Earthmother
it: Caccia con la Madre Terra

en: Bewitchments and Glamours
it: Fatture e incanti

en: Arcanic Systems Manual
it: Manuale dei sistemi arcanici

en: Fury of the Land
it: La furia della terra

en: The Horn of Xelthos
it: Il corno di Xelthos

en: Goblin Lockpicks
it: Grimaldelli goblin

en: The Horn of Xelthos
it: Il corno di Xelthos

en: Bring the Primitive Drawing to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
it: Porta il Primitive Drawing a Hemet Nesingwary, a Stranglethorn Vale.

en: Get a Crimson Trophy Quill from Gharrik in the Badlands. Then, return to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn Vale.
it: Ottieni una Crimson Trophy Quill da Gharrik nelle Badlands. Poi torna da Hemet Nesingwary a Stranglethorn Vale.

en: Terror of the Desert Skies
it: Terrore nei cieli del deserto

en: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography
it: Arcimago Antonidas: l'autobiografia integrale

en: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal
it: Il diario di ricerca dell'Arcimago Theocritus

en: The Lessons of Ta'zo
it: Le lezioni di Ta'zo

en: Find one of the Desolace marauders.
it: Trova uno dei predoni di Desolace.

en: On the Lam
it: In fuga

en: Bring a Cherry Grog to Tokal, in Booty Bay, to hear the rest of her story.
it: Porta un Cherry Grog a Tokal, a Booty Bay, per sentire il resto della sua storia.

en: Cherry for Your Thoughts?
it: Una ciliegia per i tuoi pensieri?

en: Find Illari Duskfeather on the coast of Arathi Highlands, and get access to her cache of stolen loot.
it: Trova Illari Duskfeather sulla costa degli Arathi Highlands e ottieni l'accesso al suo nascondiglio di bottino rubato.

en: No Honor Among Thieves
it: Nessun onore tra i ladri

en: Collect 5 Twisted Fire Totems, 5 Twisted Earth Totems, 5 Twisted Air Totems, and 5 Twisted Water Totems for Veyric Thunderhame in Arathi Highlands.
it: Raccogli 5 Twisted Fire Totem, 5 Twisted Earth Totem, 5 Twisted Air Totem e 5 Twisted Water Totem per Veyric Thunderhame, negli Arathi Highlands.

en: Storm, Earth, and Fire
it: Tempesta, terra e fuoco

en: Defeat 7 Defias Night Blades and 7 Defias Enchanters in Addle's Stead then return to Sirra Von'Indi in Darkshire for more information.
it: Sconfiggi 7 Defias Night Blade e 7 Defias Enchanter ad Addle's Stead, poi torna da Sirra Von'Indi a Darkshire per altre informazioni.

en: Silvia's Sword
it: La spada di Silvia

en: Find an ogre who can read the Illegible Recipe.
it: Trova un ogre che sappia leggere la Illegible Recipe.

en: Anyone Can Cook
it: Tutti possono cucinare

en: Gather the ingredients for Skonk's dish, then bring them to him in Arathi Highlands
it: Raccogli gli ingredienti per il piatto di Skonk, poi portaglieli negli Arathi Highlands

en: A Quick Grocery Run
it: Una spesa veloce

en: Taste test the recipe with Skonk.
it: Fai assaggiare la ricetta a Skonk.

en: Taste Testing
it: Prova d'assaggio

en: Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead
it: Mummie: guida ai non morti sgradevoli

en: Find a Stormscale Beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her Rod of Deep Dominion.
it: Trova una Stormscale Beastmistress, uccidila e riporta la sua Rod of Deep Dominion.

en: Holy Diver
it: Tuffatore sacro

en: Kill 8 Defias Rogue Wizards at Stone Cairn Lake, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.
it: Uccidi 8 Defias Rogue Wizard allo Stone Cairn Lake, poi torna da Hamish Bergwort nella Tower of Azora.

en: Deliver Elmpaw's Head to Helene Peltskinner near Goldshire.
it: Consegna Elmpaw's Head a Helene Peltskinner vicino a Goldshire.

en: Elmpaw's Head
it: La testa di Elmpaw

en: Kitta Firewind in the Tower of Azora wants you to collect 3 Luminous Residue. Luminous Residue can be obtained by disenchanting Crude Wax Effigies dropped by Kobold Geomancers.
